sources.title: Short-term synaptic plasticity
sources.used_for: STP classification, residual calcium hypothesis, original taxonomy of STF/STD/augmentation/PTP
sources.key_contribution: Foundational review establishing the modern taxonomy of short-term plasticity and residual calcium hypothesis for facilitation

sources.title: Short-term presynaptic plasticity
sources.journal: Cold Spring Harbor Perspectives in Biology
sources.used_for: STD mechanism (vesicle depletion model), P_r determines STP direction, Ca-dependent recovery, quantitative details
sources.key_contribution: Updated mechanistic review post-2002; mathematical framework for vesicle depletion; buffer saturation model for facilitation

sources.title: The calcium sensor synaptotagmin 7 is required for synaptic facilitation
sources.authors: Jackman SL, Turecek J, Belinsky JE, Regehr WG
sources.used_for: Syt7 as the Ca2+ sensor for STF; Syt7 KO abolishes PPF at 4 synapse types; C2A* mutant cannot rescue
sources.key_contribution: Definitive identification of Syt7 as the molecular sensor for short-term facilitation, resolving 70-year debate

sources.title: Synaptotagmin 7 confers frequency invariance onto specialized depressing synapses
sources.authors: Turecek J, Jackman SL, Regehr WG
sources.used_for: Syt7 at high-Pr depressing synapses; hidden facilitation compensates depression; frequency invariance at Purkinje→DCN synapses
sources.key_contribution: Extended Syt7 function to depressing synapses; revealed facilitation-depression balance for frequency-invariant transmission

sources.title: Synaptic theory of working memory
sources.authors: Mongillo G, Barak O, Tsodyks M
sources.access_note: Subscription required; used abstract and known theoretical content
sources.used_for: Activity-silent working memory via STF; residual Ca2+ maintains facilitated state; metabolically efficient WM
sources.key_contribution: Foundational theory proposing WM can be stored in synaptic facilitation state without persistent firing

sources.title: Progressive overfilling of readily releasable pool underlies short-term facilitation at recurrent excitatory synapses in layer 2/3 of the rat prefrontal cortex
sources.authors: Shin J, Lee SY, Kim Y, Lee SH
sources.used_for: PFC L2/3 STF via progressive overfilling; Syt7 accelerates vesicle replenishment (100ms vs 5s); Syt7 KD impairs trace fear memory
sources.key_contribution: Novel 2026 mechanism for STF when Pv≈1 (overfilling docking sites); first direct behavioral link between PFC Syt7-STF and cognitive memory

sources.title: Non-calyceal inputs gate the timing of calyx of Held evoked MNTB output
sources.used_for: Facilitating small inputs compensate depressing calyx of Held at MNTB; STP in auditory timing (ITD coding); concrete circuit example
sources.key_contribution: 2026 in vivo circuit-level evidence for complementary STD+STF enabling temporal precision in auditory sound localization

sources.title: Synaptic footprints of time in working memory
sources.authors: Grover D, Heintschel ML, et al.
sources.used_for: Extension of activity-silent WM to include temporal ordering; synaptic augmentation encodes 'when' (timing) alongside 'what' (identity)
sources.key_contribution: 2026 update to Mongillo 2008 framework: STP dynamics encode temporal sequence information in working memory

sources.title: Short-Term Synaptic Plasticity as a Mechanism for Sensory Timing
sources.authors: Motanis H, Seay MJ, Buonomano DV
sources.used_for: STP as temporal filter; depressing=low-pass, facilitating=high-pass; band-pass circuits; auditory and visual temporal selectivity
sources.key_contribution: Comprehensive review of STP-based temporal filtering in sensory circuits; circuit-level examples from anurans, electric fish, visual cortex

sources.title: Synaptic computation
sources.used_for: Conceptual framework for synapses as active computational elements; STP in neural computation overview
sources.key_contribution: Influential review framing synapses as computational units performing gain control, temporal filtering, signal routing via STP

sources.title: Role of AMPA receptor desensitization in short-term depression
sources.used_for: Postsynaptic mechanism of STD via AMPA receptor desensitization as complement to presynaptic vesicle depletion
sources.key_contribution: Review establishing AMPA receptor desensitization as distinct STD mechanism at retinogeniculate and other synapses
